scope: Current implementation inventory, not a test-run result or completion percentage. Historical per-batch proofs and retired test references are not runtime requirements.

statusDefinitions.implemented-with-bounded-tests: Implementation and maintained controlled tests exist; this file does not claim a fresh run or exhaustive combinations.
statusDefinitions.not-implemented: The dedicated original move script is not dispatched; ordinary battle rules and result presentation remain independent.
statusDefinitions.not-exhaustive: Identity or controlled scenario coverage does not establish all pairwise interactions, campaign acquisition paths or special modes.

inventory.warning: Species, map and campaign counters are deliberately not copied into this battle inventory.

boundaries.rules: Ordinary singles and preset doubles share the current battle frame and execution lifecycle. All move identities have recipe admission and controlled public-turn test rows.
boundaries.specialModes: Safari, roaming, scripted/tutorial encounters and Trainer Tower have separate application owners; ordinary-core coverage does not establish all of their outcomes. Dynamic Enigma payloads, player communication and external e-Reader inputs are not ordinary-core completion.
boundaries.presentation: 166 source move scripts are dispatched in bounded tested contexts. Future Sight covers successful setup only; its delayed-hit general animation remains open. Wish setup and the separately authenticated delayed-healing general animation are implemented in bounded contexts. Hail covers successful weather setup; its residual-weather general animation remains open. Visual randomness uses a transient identity-seeded animation-local stream, intentionally independent of the original shared gameplay/VBlank stream. Castform event-time static form art, palette and geometry are implemented; its general form-change transition remains open. Wish admission covers ordinary turn scheduling; low-level recomposition of ResolveAction on a still-Protected caster lacks an exported native animation-prevention flag. Other moves retain ordinary text/HP/result presentation; no generic-animation parity or full form-transition fidelity is claimed.
boundaries.verification: Maintained tests contain controlled states. Neither their count nor this inventory proves natural full-game travel, original-frame parity or real-speaker audio.
boundaries.userDeferrals: Chinese is deferred. The user resumed remaining single-player content, including animation and presentation, on 2026-10-16; completion still requires explicit evidence.
boundaries.approvedRules: Keep the existing approved project differences, including end-of-turn doubles KO replacement; this inventory grants no new rule changes.
boundaries.playerSaves: Stable field saves and strict Continue are separate from controlled in-battle test serialization.
